summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (MTEK/MTEKW), furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a press release dated September 28, 2026, announcing a record US$10 million order for advanced video systems on next-generation manned airborne defense platforms, its largest-ever contract, awarded under a multi-year project in collaboration with Magam Safety Ltd. If embedded purchase options are exercised, follow-on orders could raise total project value to roughly US$14.1 million, with about US$7.1 million of deliveries expected by end-2028. No special-situation transaction is implicated; the filing is an ordinary commercial order announcement with no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms, and no risk-arb angle applies.
